title: Form Of A Notice By A Sole Proprietor Partner Of A Firm Director Of A Company
description: A form of a notice by a sole proprietor partner of a firm director of a company used for dishonour of cheques or complaints under the Negotiable Instruments Act. Suitable for payees of dishonoured cheques, drawers, or their legal counsel. Key details required: Field 1 of 0.
description_hi: Form Of A Notice By A Sole Proprietor Partner Of A Firm Director Of A Company — चेक अनादर या परक्राम्य लिखत अधिनियम के तहत शिकायतें के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। अनादरित चेकों के आदाता, लेखक, या उनके कानूनी सलाहकार के लिए उपयुक्त। 1 आवश्यक विवरण भरने होंगे।
